pipeline.title: AI Integration Pipeline
pipeline.subtitle: Analyze a saved report, propose scoped file operations, test in an isolated workspace, then prepare a reviewable draft PR.
pipeline.providerDetail: Selected source is disclosed to {{baseUrl}}. Secret-like values are redacted before sending.
pipeline.providerMissingDetail: Set AI_BASE_URL, AI_API_KEY, and AI_MODEL on the server. NEXUS records the blocked job and does not fabricate generated changes.
pipeline.noSourceChanges: No source changes have been prepared for this job.
pipeline.noJobsDetail: Select a scan report and confirm source disclosure. A configured provider is required for real code generation.
pipeline.confirmPrepare: Selected source files from {{repository}} will be sent to the configured AI provider for analysis. Continue?
pipeline.confirmPr: Open a draft pull request for {{repository}} from {{branch}}? This pushes the reviewed branch. It does not merge or publish.
pipeline.confirmRetry: Retrying will send selected source files from {{repository}} to the configured AI provider. Continue?
pipeline.resultBlocked: AI change job recorded as blocked
pipeline.remoteWritesDisabled: Remote writes are disabled in server configuration

operations.title: AI Operations
operations.subtitle: Review the available source-analysis and local change workflow. Remote writes remain separately gated.
operations.providerDetail: A model-backed change proposal can start from a saved repository scan. Selected source files are disclosed only after confirmation.
operations.providerMissingDetail: Configure a provider on the server. NEXUS keeps provider keys out of browser state and records blocked work instead of fabricating results.
operations.noProvidersDetail: Set a server-side provider registry or the legacy AI_BASE_URL/API key/model values.

capabilities.evidenceReady: GitHub connection is configured for repository reads.
capabilities.evidenceBlocked: Configure GitHub access before scanning repositories.
capabilities.proposalsReady: Selected source can be sent after an explicit disclosure confirmation.
capabilities.proposalsBlocked: Requires an AI provider and a saved scan report.
capabilities.localChecksDetail: Proposed changes run in a network-disabled Docker container; offline dependency restore may block the run.
capabilities.prEnabled: Server remote-write flag is enabled; caller authentication is not provided by this application.
capabilities.prDisabled: Remote writes are disabled by server configuration.

scanner.title: Repository Scanner
scanner.subtitle: Read the default branch at a fixed commit, inspect bounded source evidence, and save one assessment per repository.
scanner.noRepositoriesDetail: Sync GitHub repositories to start collecting update evidence.
scanner.nextRun: Next run: {{time}}. Scheduling queues bounded scans and skips repositories that already have an active scan.
scanner.nextRunUnscheduled: Next run: not scheduled. Scheduling queues bounded scans and skips repositories that already have an active scan.
scanner.commitPinnedDetail: Each report records the commit SHA, selected paths, read errors and scan limits.
scanner.staticDetail: Textual configuration does not prove a valid signature or an installed client update.

adapters.title: Adapter Center
adapters.subtitle: Each adapter applies framework-native update conventions and reports repository evidence without treating text hints as verified behavior.
adapters.electronDetail: electron-updater and electron-builder release metadata, platform signing configuration and package scripts.
adapters.tauriDetail: Tauri updater plugin configuration, signed update manifest evidence and Rust build entrypoints.
adapters.pythonDetail: Desktop packaging signals with installer-specific update strategies and Python test discovery.
adapters.dotnetDetail: Velopack, MSIX and ClickOnce evidence with .NET build and test entrypoints.
adapters.webDetail: Web deployment and PWA service-worker lifecycle, manifest, and browser-managed updates.
adapters.heuristicDetail: Source evidence indicates likely configuration. Signature validity, server accessibility and old-client installation need independent verification.

updateSecurity.title: Update Security
updateSecurity.subtitle: Review transport, signing, artifact, permission and client-update evidence from repository scans.
updateSecurity.codeEvidenceDetail: {{code}} repositories show update code; {{pipeline}} show release workflow evidence.
updateSecurity.cryptoDetail: 0 signatures or digests are cryptographically verified by repository text scanning.
updateSecurity.clientDetail: 0 old-client update cycles have been executed and verified end to end.
updateSecurity.noFindingsDetail: Run repository scans to populate evidence gaps. An empty list is not proof that update controls are secure.
